narrative.intro: Black Construction Tutor Perini reported $708M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Black Construction Tutor Perini won 14 awards this fiscal year, with an average award size of $50.6M, and obligations are up 446.9% year over year. Black Construction Tutor Perini concentrated most FY2026 obligations in Commercial and Institutional Building Construction, which totaled $701M. Black Construction Tutor Perini also recorded $7.2M in New Multifamily Housing Construction (except For-Sale Builders). Historical obligations show variation: Black Construction Tutor Perini recorded $98.5M in FY21, $286M in FY22, $71.2M in FY23, $228M in FY24, and $129M in FY25. Black Construction Tutor Perini’s FY2026 totals are partial, reflecting fiscal year to date activity, and the award-value tables in reports use total contract values rather than obligations. Black Construction Tutor Perini’s current-year figures reflect contracting activity through the fiscal year to date and highlight a concentration in a single NAICS market and a small number of large awards driving the year-over-year increase.

sections.heading: How concentrated are Black Construction Tutor Perini’s FY2026 obligations?
sections.body: Black Construction Tutor Perini concentrated FY2026 obligations in Commercial and Institutional Building Construction, which accounted for $701M. Black Construction Tutor Perini recorded only $7.2M in the next-largest NAICS, New Multifamily Housing Construction (except For-Sale Builders). Black Construction Tutor Perini’s total obligations for FY2026 to date were $708M, reflecting a small number of large awards.

sections.heading: How has Black Construction Tutor Perini’s contracting changed over time?
sections.body: Black Construction Tutor Perini’s obligations by fiscal year show swings: $98.5M in FY21, $286M in FY22, $71.2M in FY23, $228M in FY24, $129M in FY25, and $708M in FY26 to date. Black Construction Tutor Perini’s FY2026 obligations are up 446.9% year over year and reflect 14 awards so far this fiscal year.
